history.author: Shane Downing
history.titleZh: 律师的八卡V100 AI服务器将DeepSeek从2-bit精度提升至接近NVFP4精度
history.descriptionZh:
一位在南卡罗来纳州哥伦比亚市执业的庭审律师 Nick Mermiges，正在把一套由八块二手 Nvidia V100 GPU 组成的私有 AI 服务器推进到新阶段。他是 PLI Labs 和 proprietarylegal.ai 的创始人，其另一家公司 PLI 是技术咨询公司，而非律所，目前还把“私有化、本地部署的大模型推理服务”作为对外服务。这套服务器用于他的法律业务，核心模型是 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash，外面套有一层“法律 harness”——即围绕模型构建的工作流、调用逻辑和检查机制。他强调“文件永远不离开办公室”，因此选择完全本地运行，而不是依赖云端 API。

这次升级的重点，是把约 80% 的推理工作从 2-bit 量化提升到 4-bit 的 NVFP4 精度，同时把系统内存从 256GB 扩到 1TB，并加入一块 RTX 3090。系统现在支持约 524K 上下文。此前新构建版本出现的崩溃，最初被怀疑是 PCIe 问题，但最终更可能是电源供应器故障；他更换了供电方案后，9 次长对话测试全部正常。增加风扇并没有改变温度，说明问题不在风道或散热。V100 已处于“借来的时间”上，Nvidia 的 R580 驱动分支是最后支持该架构的版本。

技术上的关键创新，是一种“按使用频率混用量化精度”的方案。DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 是专家混合模型：每层有 384 个路由专家，40 层合计 15,360 个专家。按官方精度，模型权重大约需要 269 GiB，而八块 32GB V100 总共只有 256 GiB 显存，尚未计算其他开销，因此完整高精度模型放不下。此前的 2-bit 版本权重约 248.8GB；新构建的 Hugging Face 包约 556GB。其做法是：所有专家仍以 2-bit 常驻显卡，然后把“最常用”的专家逐批提升到 NVFP4，直到显存装满。最终约 38.7%、即 5,949 个专家以精确 NVFP4 精度运行。“最常用”来自四类文本等权统计，其中一类就是他自己的法律 harness 流量。

这样做的收益是：这些高频专家承担了大部分实际计算。单请求测试中，80%—86% 的解码路由会落到 NVFP4 专家上，通用文本最低、源代码最高；他计划中的双请求配置预计为 78%—85%，其余 15%—22% 的专家调用仍回到 2-bit。与 Nvidia 官方 NVFP4 版本作为参考相比，新构建的“同下一 token 率”从 92.2% 提升到 95.1%；KL 散度从 0.196 nats 降到 0.079 nats；在 513 道标准多选题中，答案发生变化的题目从 79 道降到 8 道。这些指标衡量的是输出保真度，而非准确率；三种情况下准确率大致相同。相关测试是在该构建的第一个版本上完成的，尚未覆盖现在的双请求配置。

代价是性能下降。代码输出从原来的 160—215 tokens/s 降到约 150—180 tokens/s，按提示长度不同，代码输出慢 3%—30%，法律写作慢 9%—23%。详细表格显示，在 1K、32K、128K、256K 提示长度下，近 NVFP4 版本的代码输出约为 150.1—165.1 tokens/s，法律写作为 87.3—105.5 tokens/s；2-bit 版本对应更高。他原本希望法律和散文生成维持在约 80 tokens/s，实测法律写作 86—106 tokens/s、散文 78—86 tokens/s。好消息是，同时跑两个请求时总输出达到 159.0 tokens/s，高于单请求的 118.9 tokens/s；首个 token 到达时间也更早，在 256K 上下文下为 108.4 秒，对比 118.7 秒。

不过，每个并发请求都需要一个“slot”，每个 slot 要在显卡上保存自己的状态，因而会挤占 NVFP4 专家的空间：1、2、3 个 slot 分别只能容纳 6,215、5,949、5,663 个 NVFP4 专家。每增加一个 slot，可能把另外 1—2 个百分点的专家调用推回 2-bit，从而略微降低输出质量。内存升级方面，他换上了八条 128GB、2,933 MT/s 的内存；此前八条 32GB 因 ECC 错误只能跑在 DDR4-2666。升级后主机报告两个 NUMA 节点，两次启动在板间首次传输时挂起，他通过在软件中重排显卡顺序解决。GPU 频率仍限制在 1,522 MHz。

软件栈同样值得注意：他借助 Claude Code 构建软件侧，由 Opus 5.5 和 Fable 5.2 等模型在他的指导下编写内核、跑基准、做优化和重新量化。他特别提到，Fable 构建自定义 Volta 内核的能力超出预期，也能对他的法律 harness 所触发的专家进行重新量化。此前从 2 月到 7 月，他围绕 Claude 搭建的法律 harness 可用，但本地模型版本失败；DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 出现后，他才成功移植，不过也坦言它仍不如前沿闭源模型。项目名称从“Volta sPLIt”变为“Volta Max uPLIft”，继续嵌入公司缩写 PLI（Proprietary Legal Intelligence）。

应用场景上，这套系统服务于法律实践中的私有推理：法律写作、文档处理、代码辅助以及法律 harness 触发的专家调用，都能在办公室内完成，避免敏感文件外流。它已经能同时处理多个请求，满足他此前“一次处理更多工作负载”的目标。他还已运行两台 DGX Spark，用同一模型支持 1M 上下文、面向 agent 工作，并可同时开三到四个会话。下一步是扩展规模：另有八块 V100 和一台配备 512GB、3,200 MT/s ECC 内存的第二服务器待命，第二台机器将运行另一套高精度 DeepSeek，作为额外 agent 或并行任务节点；他还计划把 DeepSeek 的小型 draft 模型从 V100 移到 RTX 3090，但目前尚未实施。整体来看，这是一个以二手硬件、混合精度和 AI 辅助内核开发为核心的低成本私有大模型推理实践，在保真度、显存容量和吞吐之间做出了明确取舍。

history.title: Jensen Huang and the decline of the visionary showman founder CEO
history.description:
Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang at CES 2025 in Las Vegas, Nevada, on January 6, 2025. | Photo by Artur Widak/NurPhoto via Getty Images	

On January 6th, 2025, Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang got his rockstar moment at last. He strode triumphantly onstage, hand raised in the air, to the claps and cheers of a 14,000-person arena absolutely packed with influencers and fans, their faces awash in blue glow, as he made his entrance in a black leather jacket that shimmered in the stadium's lights.
Few are cheering for Jensen Huang now. He has left Nvidia after seemingly enabling two chip smuggling scandals and allegedly having three extramarital affairs, including one with an alleged Chinese spy at the same time he was mingling with President Donald Trump.
The world is watching to see if  …
Read the full story at The Verge.
history.content: On January 6th, 2025, Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang got his rockstar moment at last. He strode triumphantly onstage, hand raised in the air, to the claps and cheers of a 14,000-person arena absolutely packed with influencers and fans, their faces awash in blue glow, as he made his entrance in a black leather jacket that shimmered in the stadium’s lights.Few are cheering for Jensen Huang now. He has left Nvidia after seemingly enabling two chip smuggling scandals and allegedly having three extramarital affairs, including one with an alleged Chinese spy at the same time he was mingling with President Donald Trump.The world is watching to see if this scandal might disrupt the entire US AI industry and perhaps destabilize the stock market along with it. That’s because Huang wasn’t merely running the first $5 trillion company, he was the visionary leader in control of the must-have GPUs powering the worldwide AI boom, part of a company that represents around 6 percent of the S&P 500 stock market index all by itself. And he didn’t plan for succession if he ever stepped down.The 63-year-old once said he preferred to die on the job; he once suggested he’d work until he was 90 or 100, then carry on leading the company as a robot.It’s not easy to replace Huang, partly because he had no deputies. Around 60 employees reported directly to the CEO. “He built the company around himself, and everything that happened there flowed through him,” says IDC analyst and former computing journalist Tom Mainelli.“Jensen is Nvidia, and Nvidia is Jensen,” Jon Peddie, a computer industry analyst who’s been tracking Nvidia since its inception, tells me.But Nvidia isn’t Jensen anymore. He has left the company he cofounded 33 years ago. It’s the end of an era, and not just for Nvidia — because Jensen Huang was Big Tech’s last true example of a visionary showman founder CEO.“He was both the visionary and the tactical leader, the closest thing tech has had to Steve Jobs,” Moor Insights & Strategy chief analyst Pat Moorhead tells me.Elon Musk didn’t exactly found Tesla and has quite the track record of broken promises, and Meta’s Mark Zuckerberg has proven to be neither visionary nor showman so far. Google’s Larry Page and Sergey Brin stepped away in 2019 as their company dealt with growing employee turmoil, leaving the company in the hands of Sundar Pichai, and both Microsoft and Apple have each passed the torch twice since the days of Bill Gates and Steve Jobs.Some say Apple’s Steve Jobs broke the CEO mold, but he created a mold of his own. Huang was one of countless tech leaders who followed his example by introducing their products in keynote speeches, adopting a single recognizable piece of clothing like Jobs’ trademark black turtleneck, and even occasionally teasing “one more thing” for the surprise at the end of their presentations. In the newsroom, we’d sometimes joke about the Jobs wannabes; many were stiff suits who didn’t have the credibility to pull it off.I thought Huang might be a Jobs wannabe, too, the first time I saw that he’d adopted a black jacket as his uniform. (It was not always a leather jacket; an earlier version was a Nvidia-branded softshell.) Huang later insisted on wearing a jacket even when the temperature was hot — more than once, I saw him sweat profusely rather than take it off. Unlike Jobs, he also held quite a few keynotes when he didn’t have much news to share; he liked to repeat the company’s previous accomplishments as if they were brand-new.But even if Huang didn’t have the same gravitas as Jobs, he did have exciting tech up his sleeves and loved to demo it onstage. He knew how to get people excited about the future of visual computing with eye-opening gaming graphics, physics and lighting demos, and eventually image recognition, AI weather simulations, digital copies of real-world factories, and the robots that can virtually train in them.His Nvidia tried to educate people about the how and why of GPUs, too; I still remember in 2008 when Nvidia invited the Mythbusters to demo the difference between serial processing and parallel processing by firing a 1,100-nozzle paintball gun to “paint” the Mona Lisa in one shot.What I didn’t know back then: Huang was a visionary founder. He took Nvidia to fame and fortune through a series of tremendous bets.In 1996, three years after he cofounded the company at a Denny’s diner, Nvidia nearly went out of business while working on a failed graphics chip for the Sega Dreamcast game console. But even though he didn’t deliver that chip, Huang personally convinced Sega to invest $5 million afterward, The Wall Street Journal reported in 2024.He then turned around and bet the company again on the Riva 128 PC graphics accelerator, an effort so ambitious he had to lay off over half of Nvidia’s roughly 100 staffers, skip the prototyping stage, and rush it straight to production, and he still only had one month of payroll left by the time it shipped, The New Yorker wrote in 2023. Thankfully, it was a success, selling a million units in just four months and paving the way for both the GeForce GPU and a long-term relationship with chip fabricator TSMC.Roughly eight years later, Huang decided it wasn’t enough to be the leader in PC gaming graphics alone. He bet the company’s entire gross profit, he told podcaster Lex Fridman, on shipping a new feature inside those graphics cards that no one had asked for: CUDA. It was the ability to use a GPU for other kinds of computing tasks beyond graphics, and Huang said it increased the cost of every GeForce graphics card by 50 percent.“Originally there was no market or market demand for it. It was almost as if they built it because they could,” says Peddie. “Jensen had the vision for what it could be and the courage to pursue it in spite of the opinions of others.”“NVIDIA was effectively investing in a computing platform that extended far beyond graphics, with no guarantee of a near-term return,” says HotTech analyst Dave Altavilla.“Huang saw that a GPU was really a parallel computer that happened to render graphics. CUDA turned that insight into a platform, and it’s why NVIDIA was ready when AI arrived,” Mainelli tells me.It was a bad time for graphics cards to suddenly cost more. When the Great Recession hit in 2007–2009, and Nvidia laptop graphics chips also started failing due to design defects, the company lost 80 percent of its market value.But Huang believed in CUDA enough to invest even more. “He literally handed out high-end NVIDIA GPUs to researchers at industry conferences, while the company seeded universities like Stanford with hardware to encourage development on its platform,” says Altavilla. And by 2012, Nvidia’s potential for AI had started to emerge.That’s when University of Toronto researchers used Nvidia GPUs to train a prize-winning image-recognition neural network called AlexNet, which is widely credited for sparking the AI revolution.Not all of Huang’s visions panned out the way he publicly expected. That AlexNet demo directly led to Huang’s bets on chips for self-driving cars, he said, but he didn’t exactly predict AI — CUDA was instead thought of as better and more affordable supercomputing for researchers and scientists. In 2013, I also wrote about how his grand plan for the future of the company relied heavily on putting Nvidia chips in your phone, which didn’t pan out.But that bet on ARM-based phone chips did put Nvidia inside every Nintendo Switch and may have helped make future “AI superchips” possible — the latest Nvidia AI server chips have ARM CPU cores. And in 2022, the leaders of the AI revolution launched the most groundbreaking AI tech yet on Nvidia hardware: ChatGPT. Six years earlier, Huang hand-delivered Nvidia’s first purpose-built AI workstation to OpenAI, and by 2022 Microsoft had strung together tens of thousands of Nvidia A100 GPUs to handle the load.“Our strategy, ultimately, is to light every single pixel,” Huang said at the March 2013 event where I took this photo. Photo by Sean Hollister / The VergeHuang projected that Nvidia would power 500 million phones, 200 million tablets, and 50 million cars in the 2017 timeframe. Photo by Sean Hollister / The Verge“Every time competitors got close, he moved the fight up a level: the chip, then the server, then networking with the $6.9 billion Mellanox deal, then the full rack, all tied together by CUDA,” says Moorhead. “The speed came from how he ran the company,” he adds. “Decisions that took other companies four weeks took Nvidia four days.”“Decisions that took other companies four weeks took Nvidia four days.”As Nvidia’s fortunes and profit ballooned — thousands of dollars in pure profit every single second! — and as it became clearer that AI would reshape the world in one way or another, something strange happened. Huang became a celebrity. In summer 2024, The Wall Street Journal and social media chronicled that he received a hero’s welcome in his birthplace of Taiwan. He stopped over and over to sign autographs, including one on a woman’s chest.In person, at presentations, and in the company’s investor Q&As, I saw the tone shift. People began treating the leather-jacketed man like an actual rockstar instead of a wannabe rockstar, asking for photos and autographs and complimenting him rather than asking tough questions.It felt like he’d attained Steve Jobs’ infamous “reality distortion field” at last — until he popped that bubble himself with his infidelity.But one fewer reality distortion field in the world isn’t necessarily a bad thing, and as Apple has shown, a company doesn’t go bust just because its charismatic founder is gone. Tim Cook made Apple the most profitable company in the world. The question now is: who for Nvidia?“He was the king,” says Peddie. “Make no mistake – it was the Jensen Huang company. He called all the shots, took all the glory, and shouldered all the blame.”Does Nvidia work without Huang?Even without a named successor, analysts don’t think Nvidia is in big trouble yet.“This is a stock shock, not a business shock, for the next year. The roadmap and manufacturing are locked in through 2027,” says Pat Moorhead, Moor Insights & Strategy. “The question is whether Nvidia keeps inventing at Jensen’s pace once those plans run out. The bigger risk than any rival chip is customers hedging during a vacuum. That is why the next CEO needs technical credibility, an operating model that doesn’t depend on one person, and a plan to protect CUDA.”“Founder visionary, culture setter, leader, AI industry spokesperson etc., is the real loss. We don’t think anything changes strategically,” says Creative Strategies analyst Ben Bajarin.” The product roadmap is set and remains strong, and the next several generations are already in design, in tape-out or on order. NVIDIA is still the company best placed to ship its roadmap at scale, because it has spent years locking up the supply chain behind it, from leading-edge wafers and CoWoS-class packaging to HBM and the rack-level partners. That supply position does not walk out the door with one person.”“He was the consummate showman, salesman, and visionary for NVIDIA, so he will be hard to replace,” says IDC analyst Tom Mainelli. “But the company’s technology road map is sound, and the team behind him is still there. Choosing the right person to replace him will be key, and there will undoubtedly be bumps along the way. But the company will survive.”“Jensen built an exceptionally talented organization with a deep engineering bench, a mature, heavily-resourced software ecosystem, and strong customer relationships,” says Dave Altavilla, HotTech Vision and Analysis. “His departure undoubtedly leaves a leadership and strategic vision gap, but the technology, talent, and execution capabilities he helped establish aren’t going away. The real question is whether his successor can sustain that same long-term vision and willingness to invest ahead of the market.”“No one in the company really wants to step into his shoes, so an outsider is going to have to be found,” says Jon Peddie of Jon Peddie Research. “Whoever that is will not be Jensen, won’t have the same ambitions, the same contacts and relationships, the same vision, or the same courage to make big, long-term bets. We’ve seen this in Apple, AMD, Intel, and other companies. So the stock will probably get battered around a bit until investors see some stability and fewer ‘what if’ questions.”
history.author: Sean Hollister
history.titleZh: 黄仁勋与远见卓识的表演型创始人CEO的衰落
history.descriptionZh:
这篇英文报道以2025年1月6日黄仁勋在1.4万人场馆中的“摇滚明星式”主题演讲开场：他身穿黑色皮衣、在蓝色灯光和欢呼中登场，象征其作为AI芯片时代核心人物的公众形象。随后叙事急转，原文称黄仁勋已离开英伟达，并声称他此前似乎卷入两起芯片走私丑闻，还被指有三段婚外情，其中一人据称是中国间谍，同时他与美国总统特朗普有交往。该文称，外界正在观察这一 scandal 是否会冲击美国AI产业乃至股市。需要说明的是，这些走私与私人生活指控均属于原文叙事，未在文中给出独立证据，若作为新闻发布应进行事实核查。原文强调，黄仁勋不只是全球首家市值5万亿美元公司的CEO，更是掌握全球AI热潮所需GPU的远见型领导者；英伟达一家公司约占标普500指数6%的权重，且黄仁勋没有安排继任计划。他63岁，曾表示宁愿在工作中死去，甚至说会工作到90或100岁，再以机器人形式继续领导公司。

原文用大量篇幅回顾黄仁勋如何把英伟达从濒临倒闭做成AI算力平台。1993年前后，他在Denny’s餐厅参与创立英伟达；1996年，公司为世嘉Dreamcast开发图形芯片失败，几乎倒闭，但黄仁勋说服世嘉投资500万美元。随后他再次“押上公司”，跳过原型阶段直接量产Riva 128 PC图形加速器，裁员超过当时约100名员工的一半，产品出货时只剩一个月工资，但Riva 128四个月卖出100万颗，为GeForce GPU和与台积电的长期合作铺路。约八年后，黄仁勋不满足于只做PC游戏图形领导者，决定把公司全部毛利润押在一个当时“没人要求”的功能上：CUDA。其核心原理是让GPU不再只做图形渲染，而能通过并行计算执行通用计算任务；GPU拥有大量并行流处理器，适合矩阵、张量和大规模数据并行运算，CUDA则提供编程模型、工具链和生态，把GPU变成通用并行计算平台。原文称，CUDA使每块GeForce显卡成本增加50%，当时没有明确市场需求，几乎像“因为能做所以做了”。2007—2009年金融危机期间，英伟达笔记本图形芯片又因设计缺陷故障，公司市值损失80%，但黄仁勋仍继续投资CUDA，向研究人员赠送高端GPU，并向斯坦福等大学提供硬件，培育开发者生态。2012年，多伦多大学研究者用英伟达GPU训练出AlexNet图像识别神经网络，被视为点燃AI革命的重要事件。原文还提到，黄仁勋2013年曾大力押注手机ARM芯片，虽未完全按预期发展，却让英伟达进入每台Nintendo Switch，并为后续含ARM CPU核心的“AI超级芯片”埋下伏笔；2016年英伟达向OpenAI亲手交付首台专用AI工作站，2022年微软用数万颗英伟达A100 GPU支撑ChatGPT负载。英伟达还通过69亿美元收购Mellanox补齐网络能力，从芯片、服务器、网络到整机架系统层层升级，并以CUDA绑定生态。原文引述分析师称，其他公司需四周的决策，英伟达可能四天完成。

从性能参数看，原文没有给出具体GPU算力、显存带宽、功耗等芯片规格，主要提供的是商业与生态数据：英伟达市值达5万亿美元、占标普500约6%；CUDA使显卡成本增加50%；2007—2009年市值缩水80%；Riva 128四个月销售100万颗；Mellanox交易69亿美元；黄仁勋曾有约60名员工直接向他汇报；2017年前后他曾预计英伟达将驱动5亿部手机、2亿台平板和5000万辆汽车；2024年他在台湾受到英雄式欢迎。技术影响和应用场景覆盖游戏图形、物理与光照演示、图像识别、AI天气模拟、真实工厂数字副本、机器人在虚拟环境中训练、自动驾驶、手机/平板/汽车、Nintendo Switch、AI工作站与服务器，以及ChatGPT等大模型训练和推理。原文认为，黄仁勋的关键创新不只是单颗芯片，而是提前把GPU定位为并行计算平台，并用CUDA、开发者生态、大学种子计划和供应链锁定形成长期壁垒；其风格也被比作乔布斯，是“远见者+战术领导者”，也是大型科技公司中最后一位真正的表演型创始人CEO。

在继任与影响分析上，原文称黄仁勋没有副手、没有公开接班人，公司围绕他构建，“Jensen就是Nvidia，Nvidia就是Jensen”。但多位分析师认为，短期更像“股票冲击”而非“业务冲击”：产品路线图和制造计划已锁定到2027年，未来几代产品已在设计、流片或下单；英伟达多年锁定领先晶圆、CoWoS级先进封装、HBM和机架级伙伴，供应链位置不会随一人离开而消失。真正的风险是：当既定计划用完后，英伟达能否保持黄仁勋式的创新速度；客户在权力真空期进行对冲，可能比竞争对手芯片更危险；下一任CEO需要技术信誉、不依赖单人的运营模式，并保护CUDA生态。分析师称，创始人远见、文化塑造者、AI行业代言人的损失很大，但技术、人才和执行能力仍在，英伟达仍是最有能力大规模交付路线图的公司。由于内部可能无人愿意接任，或需寻找外部人选；继任者不会拥有黄仁勋同样的野心、人脉、远见和长期下注勇气，股价可能波动，直到投资者看到稳定。原文以苹果在乔布斯之后由Tim Cook实现更高盈利为例，认为 charismatic founder 离开不必然导致公司崩塌，但英伟达的问题变成“谁来接替黄仁勋”。

history.title: Nearly 20 years after launch, ancient AMD Radeon HD 2000 and 3000 GPUs finally get a Linux fix for corrupted video playback
history.description: A new kernel contributor used AI to develop a patch for the drivers powering his nearly-20-year-old Radeon GPU.
history.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 0 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter A newly accepted kernel patch slated for the upcoming Linux 7.5 release finally resolves a long-standing hardware video decoding bug on AMD's ancient R600 architecture, nearly two decades after the cards first hit store shelves. As spotted by Phoronix, the fix targets the Unified Video Decoder (UVD) engine across the RV610, RV620, RV630, RV635, and RV670 silicon families, making up the Radeon HD 2000 and HD 3000 families released starting in 2007. Linux users running these cards experienced visual corruption during hardware-accelerated video playback whenever the GPU was simultaneously handling active 3D or desktop drawing workloads; those issues should now be resolved.I investigated video corruption on my older iMac7,1 (RV610/M74, device ID 1002:94c8). When the decoder was reading compressed video from system memory while the GPU was drawing, it would corrupt video frames. Moving the input to VRAM allowed frames to decode correctly. Disabling graphics draws also stopped the corruption. Here is a proposal to keep UVD buffers in VRAM for this family of devices, as the driver already does for some other chips. The patch covers RV610, RV620, RV630, RV635 and RV670. These chips share the RV6xx decoder path and legacy R600 firmware, so I think they are likely to have the same hardware requirements. Someone with the other hardware would need to verify that. I tested this on Debian. I used Codex to help with the investigation, testing and patch.Ted Bullock, first-time kernel contributorInterestingly, the breakthrough didn't come from a grizzled veteran of the open-source graphics stack, but from a newcomer utilizing OpenAI's Codex to help untangle the legacy driver path. The culprit turned out to be a memory placement oversight: the driver wasn't consistently keeping UVD input buffers pinned inside dedicated VRAM. When graphics draw calls competed for resources, frames failed to decode properly. By forcing those buffers to stay in VRAM — a behavior the Radeon kernel driver apparently already enforced for several other chip families — video playback cleans right up.It is easy to forget just how pivotal the R600 generation was for PC graphics. Launching in 2007 as the first desktop GPU lineup built under the AMD banner following that firm's blockbuster acquisition of the Canadian ATI Technologies Inc., the Radeon HD 2000 series marked the new AMD graphics division's transition away from separate pixel and vertex pipelines on the desktop, after implementing the tech first for the Xbox 360. The move to a unified shader architecture arrived alongside DirectX 10 and Windows Vista, so it was a time of many transitions.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: A die shot of the ATI R600 GPU, showing off the four SIMD clusters of then-novel unified shaders. (Image credit: Martijn Boer/Public Domain)While the flagship Radeon HD 2900 XT famously struggled against Nvidia's dominant GeForce 8800 GTX in raw gaming rasterization and power draw, the R600 family brought serious multimedia chops to the table. The introduction of the first-generation Unified Video Decoder (UVD) on the mainstream RV610 and RV630 chips, and later the refined RV670 powering the beloved Radeon HD 3850 and 3870, allowed even budget PCs to offload heavy H.264 and VC-1 Blu-ray decoding from the CPU. In 2007, smooth 1080p playback without maxing out a dual-core processor was a major selling point for many users, but none more so than home theater PC (HTPC) builders.Of course, almost nobody is daily driving a TeraScale 1 graphics card in 2026, especially when modern integrated graphics run circles around them at a fraction of the wattage; the contributor who submitted the patches wants them for his ancient Core 2 Duo-based iMac. Yet, there is something quietly heartwarming about the longevity of open-source Linux drivers. Whereas proprietary Windows support for the HD 2000 and 3000 series was sunsetted over a decade ago, the mainline Linux kernel continues to carry the torch. Combined with recent AI-assisted cleanup efforts across the Mesa R600 user-space driver, vintage Radeon hardware is arguably in better software shape today than it was during its actual retail lifespan. history.titleZh: 发布近20年后，古老的AMD Radeon HD 2000和3000 GPU终于获得Linux修复，解决视频播放损坏问题
history.descriptionZh:
一项已被接纳、计划进入即将发布的 Linux 7.5 内核的补丁，终于修复了 AMD R600 架构上长期存在的硬件视频解码缺陷。受影响的显卡最早于 2007 年上市，距今已近二十年。此次修复针对 Radeon HD 2000 和 HD 3000 系列所采用的统一视频解码器（UVD）引擎，覆盖 RV610、RV620、RV630、RV635 和 RV670 等芯片家族。此前，Linux 用户在这些显卡上启用硬件加速视频播放时，如果 GPU 同时还在处理 3D 渲染或桌面绘制任务，就会出现视频画面损坏；该问题现在应已得到解决。

问题的根因并不是解码算法本身，而是驱动对 UVD 输入缓冲区的内存放置不一致。提交者发现，当解码器从系统内存读取压缩视频数据、同时 GPU 又在进行图形绘制时，视频帧会被破坏；把输入缓冲区移到显存（VRAM）后，画面即可正确解码，而关闭图形绘制也能避免损坏。补丁的做法是强制将这一代芯片的 UVD 缓冲区保留在专用 VRAM 中，类似 Radeon 内核驱动已经对部分其他芯片家族采取的策略。由于 RV610、RV620、RV630、RV635 和 RV670 共用 RV6xx 解码路径和旧版 R600 固件，提交者推测它们具有相同硬件需求，但其他硬件仍需实际验证。该修复在 Debian 上完成了测试。

值得注意的是，这次突破来自一位首次参与内核贡献的开发者 Ted Bullock，而非开源图形栈的资深维护者。他借助 OpenAI 的 Codex 协助排查遗留驱动路径、测试并生成补丁。其测试平台是一台较老的 iMac7,1，使用的是 RV610/M74，设备 ID 为 1002:94c8。这说明 AI 辅助工具在遗留代码分析、问题定位和补丁开发中正在发挥作用。

从历史背景看，R600 是 PC 图形领域一个重要的转折点。2007 年，AMD 完成对加拿大 ATI Technologies 的收购后，Radeon HD 2000 系列成为 AMD 品牌下首代桌面 GPU 产品线，标志着桌面显卡从分离的像素和顶点管线转向统一着色器架构——这一技术此前已率先用于 Xbox 360。该转变与 DirectX 10 和 Windows Vista 的普及同步发生。虽然旗舰 Radeon HD 2900 XT 在传统游戏光栅化性能和功耗上不敌 Nvidia 的 GeForce 8800 GTX，但 R600 家族在多媒体能力上有明显优势：主流 RV610 和 RV630 首次引入第一代 UVD，后续改进的 RV670 则用于广受欢迎的 Radeon HD 3850 和 3870，使低预算 PC 也能把繁重的 H.264 和 VC-1 Blu-ray 解码从 CPU 卸载到 GPU。2007 年，在不占满双核处理器的情况下实现流畅 1080p 播放，对家庭影院 PC（HTPC）用户尤其有吸引力。

此次补丁并不带来新的性能跑分提升，也不会让这些老卡重新胜任现代游戏；它的实际价值是消除硬件加速视频播放中的画面损坏，提升老平台在 Linux 下的视频播放稳定性。如今几乎没人会把 TeraScale 1 架构显卡当作日常主力，现代核显在极低功耗下就能远超这些老卡，但开源 Linux 驱动的长期维护仍具有意义：Windows 上 HD 2000/3000 系列的专有支持十多年前就已终止，而主线 Linux 内核仍在延续支持。结合近期 Mesa R600 用户态驱动中借助 AI 进行的清理工作，这批复古 Radeon 硬件今天的软件状态，甚至可能比其零售生命周期内更好。

Read the full story at The Verge.
history.content: Amazon has plans to build a vault of data on every product sold anywhere on the internet, even products Amazon doesn’t sell, and make the information available through its own site, according to Reuters. The project, called the “World Product Graph,” is meant to make it less likely that shoppers leave Amazon to do their product research on Reddit or Google, and make it more likely shoppers end up at Amazon even if they’re searching for a product sold elsewhere. The same goes for AI agents — if Amazon has the largest stockpile of shopping data, AI agents may rely on its index of products over others, so even people shopping with bots will end up on its pages.Links to outside retailers’ products have already started popping up on Amazon through the “shop direct” feature it launched last year. The company also has its own AI shopping assistant, Alexa for Shopping, previously called Rufus. The World Product Graph project would also be aimed at fixing issues with the AI by providing it more data. According to Reuters, an internal Amazon document on the project says “Many Rufus answers are factually wrong or incomplete” and running users’ Amazon searches with the AI is expensive. Adding more data is reportedly supposed to make the system more accurate and able to use cheaper models.RelatedAmazon blocks Meta’s Muse AI agentAmazon will let you text Alexa your shopping listWhether this actually ships is still up in the air. The internal document reportedly says the project “depends on discovering how brands organize their products on their own websites,” which could involve Amazon crawling other retailers’ sites. Reuters says it’s unclear “if or when this plan may be implemented,” but said the document on it included an October 1st, 2027 release date.Amazon said in a statement to Reuters that “Draft, outdated documents often paint an incomplete picture and the existence of a brainstorming document such as this one doesn’t necessarily reflect our current plans.”
history.author: Stevie Bonifield
history.titleZh: 亚马逊计划索引全球在线购物数据
history.descriptionZh:
亚马逊据路透社报道正筹划建设一个覆盖互联网上所有销售商品的数据库，名为“World Product Graph”（世界商品图谱）。该数据库不仅收录亚马逊自营或平台上销售的商品，还计划覆盖在互联网其他渠道销售、甚至亚马逊并不销售的商品，并通过亚马逊自家网站向用户提供相关信息。其核心目标是减少消费者为了研究商品而离开亚马逊、转向Reddit或Google等外部平台的行为，同时让用户即使在搜索其他零售商销售的商品时，也更可能最终进入亚马逊页面。报道指出，这一逻辑同样适用于AI购物代理：如果亚马逊拥有最大规模的购物数据储备，AI代理可能更倾向依赖亚马逊的商品索引，从而让使用机器人购物的消费者也落到亚马逊页面上。

在业务基础上，亚马逊去年已推出“shop direct”功能，开始在其平台上出现外部零售商商品的链接；公司还拥有AI购物助手“Alexa for Shopping”，此前名为Rufus。World Product Graph也被视为修复和增强该AI助手的重要数据基础。路透社称，一份亚马逊内部文件显示，“Rufus的许多回答在事实上是错误的或不完整的”，并且用AI运行用户的亚马逊搜索成本较高。增加更多商品数据据称可提升系统准确性，并使其能够使用更便宜的模型，从而在效果和成本之间取得改善。不过原文未给出具体的性能参数或量化对比数据，只披露了准确性不足和推理成本高的问题。

从技术原理看，该项目本质上是要构建大规模商品知识图谱或商品数据索引：聚合品牌官网、其他零售商网站等多源商品信息，识别品牌如何组织其产品页面和商品数据，并对商品信息进行标准化和关联，再用于亚马逊站内搜索、商品研究和AI助手回答。其创新点和战略意义在于跨零售商、跨网站的商品覆盖，尤其是纳入亚马逊不直接销售的商品，从而把“商品研究”和“购物入口”留在亚马逊生态内，并为第三方AI代理提供商品索引基础设施。这也意味着项目可能涉及爬取其他零售商站点，实施难度和不确定性较高。

报道同时强调，该计划是否最终落地仍不确定。内部文件称项目“取决于能否发现品牌如何在自己的网站上组织产品”，这可能涉及亚马逊抓取其他零售商网站；路透社称尚不清楚该计划“是否或何时”实施，但文件提到2027年10月1日的发布日期。亚马逊对路透社回应称，草稿和过时文件往往呈现不完整图景，此类头脑风暴文件的存在不一定反映公司当前计划。相关报道还提到，亚马逊此前阻止Meta的Muse AI代理，并允许用户通过短信向Alexa发送购物清单。总体来看，World Product Graph反映亚马逊试图以商品数据图谱巩固搜索和AI购物入口，但项目仍处于早期或不明确阶段。
